findings.current: “T-Twelve years ago. Grrk. My father and mother, my little brother… Cough.”
findings.defect: The draft identifies the younger sibling as a brother, though the source gives no gender.
findings.rationale: 동생 specifies a younger sibling, not a brother.
findings.replacement: “T-Twelve years ago. Grrk. My father and mother, my younger sibling… Cough.”

findings.current: The Embroidered Uniform Guard is responsible for the Inner Palace, though the Imperial Guard protecting the Outer Palace is elite enough in its own right.
findings.defect: The draft omits that the Embroidered Uniform Guard is the Emperor’s personal guard.
findings.rationale: 황제 직속 친위대 establishes the Guard’s direct relationship to the Emperor and the hierarchy between the two palace defenses.
findings.replacement: The Imperial Guard protecting the Outer Palace is elite enough, but the Inner Palace is guarded by the Embroidered Uniform Guard—the Emperor’s personal guard.
findings.source: 외궁을 지키는 금위군도 충분히 정예병이지만, 내궁 경비는 황제 직속 친위대인 금의위가 맡고 있죠.

findings.current: If the proud ancestors of Fire Gate had seen this, they would have wept underground… or maybe not.
findings.defect: The established organization name is shortened.
findings.rationale: 열화문 has the binding rendering “Fire Gate Clan.”
findings.replacement: If the proud ancestors of the Fire Gate Clan had seen this, they would have wept underground… or maybe not.
findings.source: 자랑스러운 열화문의 선조들께서 이 광경을 보았다면

findings.current: Isn’t dying young practically a Fire Gate tradition?
findings.defect: The established organization name is shortened again.
findings.rationale: The source names 열화문 and says 우리, “our.”
findings.replacement: Isn’t dying young practically a tradition in our Fire Gate Clan?
findings.source: 툭하면 요절(夭折)하는 게 우리 열화문의 전통 아닙니까.

findings.current: Taishan—or Geosan, as you called him—is enormous.
findings.defect: “As you called him” assigns the mistaken name to the listener rather than preserving the speaker’s own correction.
findings.rationale: The Divine Physician says the first name, corrects himself, and then continues; he does not attribute the name to Jeok Cheongang.
findings.source: 태산. 아니, 거산 저 친구의 덩치가 워낙 거대하니

findings.current: Her eyes widened in surprise, then she threw herself face-first onto the ground.
findings.defect: The draft changes her surprised blink into widened eyes.
findings.rationale: 눈을 깜빡이더니 describes blinking, not widening her eyes.
findings.replacement: She blinked in surprise, then threw herself face-first onto the ground.
findings.source: 청초한 미모를 자랑하는 기녀는 깜짝 놀라 눈을 깜빡이더니 이내 몸을 내던지듯 바닥에 엎드렸다.

findings.current: As Taishan blinked vacantly, Jeok Cheongang lowered his head and thought.
findings.defect: Taishan looks around blankly; he does not blink.
findings.rationale: 눈을 굴리는 describes his eyes moving, while 멀뚱멀뚱 conveys his blank expression.
findings.replacement: As Taishan looked around blankly, Jeok Cheongang lowered his head and thought.
findings.source: 멀뚱멀뚱 눈을 굴리는 태산의 모습에, 적천강은 고개를 숙이며 생각했다.

summary: The draft is largely faithful, but it assigns an unspecified sibling a gender, omits who commands the Inner Palace guard, and alters several smaller details.
